verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a CLI security scanner like Trivy, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, usage tracking, or an opt-out flag or setting. The docs cover scanning, SBOM, MCP and caching, none of which addresses this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
